title: 第5章 路遇劫修陆成的目标第6章 外门弟子查命案寻宝鼠
slug: 凡人修仙我让高冷女宗主孕气十足
content_zh:
陆成离开黑市后，与废丹院的方向背道而驰，向南而行，走了足足三个时辰，又绕回到西边。
他离开黑市后就发现，有两个黑袍身影一直跟在他身后百米外。
神识一扫，那二人修为不高，一个炼气三层，一个炼气二层。
起初他以为对方兴许正是南行，谁知当他改变方向向杂役峰走去时。
跟在他身后百米外的两个黑影竟随着他的路线也向西而来。
哪有这么巧的事？
陆成猜测，他在黑市上被盯上了！
这是有人要杀人夺宝。
跟在他身后的两个黑影看到陆成停留在山沟内，脚步一顿，其中一人声音沙哑，带着戏谑道：
“警惕性倒是不错，交出你方才黑市上购买的象甲功，我发发善心，饶你一命！”
说着，他二人手中均陡然出现一把长剑，速度陡然加快，一前一后把陆成围在中间。
瘦小的炼气三层修士嘿嘿怪笑，目光在陆成的身上上下打量着，姿态颇高，傲然道：“有意思，杂役峰的弟子竟然出手如此阔绰，看来你身上有宝贝啊！”
陆成冰冷的目光扫过二人，眼神没有任何惊慌，反而如潭水般平静。
“就凭你们？”
炼气二层的修士被这目光盯得浑身不自然，低吼道：“找死！”
话音未落，他与那瘦小修士同时发难。
瘦小修士拿出一把寒光闪闪的长剑，长剑在他手中破空而起，他用引力决催动长剑直刺陆成胸口；炼气二层修士手中同样出现一把长剑，同样直刺向陆成后背。
二人嘴角噙着狞笑，一前一后，出手便是杀招，攻势狠辣，显然是常做这种杀人越货的勾当！
面对前后袭来的长剑，陆成丝毫不慌，不闪不避，手中瞬间出现一张仙符，仙符瞬间被他捏爆！
轰！

陆成脚下大地轰隆一声瞬间裂开，一条三米宽的沟壑陡然出现在他脚下，陆成的身体骤然下降，眨眼间消失在裂缝中。
“该死！”瘦小修士嘴角笑容僵住，他没想到陆成如此果断，黑市购买的仙符竟然一点都不心疼的就用了，连忙操控飞剑回到手中。
他和另一位炼气二层的修士来到裂缝边缘向内看去，无尽灰尘从地缝内涌出，看不到陆成的身影。
就在二人用灵气将地缝内的灰尘排空、寻找陆成身影时，
轰！
突然，一道火光从地缝内以极快的速度喷涌而出，炼气二层修士闪避不及，火球直接撞在了他的脸上。
“啊啊啊……”炼气二层修士瞬间痛苦哀嚎，火球逐渐将他整个身子吞噬，他连忙倒在地上，左右翻滚，试图扑灭身上的火焰。
瘦小修士一惊，连忙向地缝对面跳去，过去帮同伴灭火。
就在他从地缝上空跳跃过去的刹那间，地缝中陡然出现一把长剑，长剑速度极快，犹如闪电般升空，直直刺向他的屁股。
瘦小修士突然感觉下面凉飕飕的，一股寒意涌上心头，暗道一声“不好，中计了”，想要闪躲已是来不及，只能努力做出百米冲刺般跳远的姿势。
嗤！
长剑犹如切豆腐般瞬间没入他没及时抽回的脚掌！
瘦小修士脚掌被刺穿，脚上带着一柄贯穿的长剑跳到对面，然后来了个驴打滚，疼得眼泪都掉了下来。
陆成纵身一跳，来到地面后，疾冲向瘦小修士，拔出他脚上的长剑，在瘦小修士震惊的眼神中，直接砍掉了一旁另外一个炼气二层修士的头颅。
content_en:
After Lu Cheng left the black market, he ran in the opposite direction of the Abandoned Pill Academy and headed south. After walking for three hours, he circled back to the west.
After he left the black market, he discovered that two figures in black robes had been following him a hundred meters away.
With a sweep of his spiritual consciousness, he found that the two people were not very high in cultivation. One was at the third level of Qi Refining and the other was at the second level of Qi Refining.
At first he thought that the other party might be heading south, but when he changed direction and walked towards Zaoyu Peak.
The two black figures following him a hundred meters away actually followed his route to the west.
How could such a coincidence happen?
Lu Cheng guessed that he was being targeted on the black market!
This is someone who wants to kill someone and seize the treasure.
The two black figures following him paused when they saw Lu Cheng staying in the ravine. One of them said in a hoarse voice, jokingly:
"You must be vigilant. Hand over the Elephant Armor Technique you just bought on the black market. I will spare your life as a kindness!"
As he spoke, a long sword suddenly appeared in both of their hands, and their speed suddenly increased, surrounding Lu Cheng one after another.
The thin third-level Qi Refining monk chuckled strangely, looking up and down Lu Cheng's body, with a rather high posture, and said proudly: "It's interesting that the disciples of the Miscellaneous Peak are so generous. It seems that you have a treasure!"
Lu Cheng's cold eyes swept across the two of them. There was no panic in his eyes, but instead they were as calm as a pool of water.
"Just you?"
The monk on the second level of Qi Refining was so uneasy with this gaze that he growled: "Seeking death!"
Before he finished speaking, he and the thin monk attacked at the same time.
The thin monk took out a long sword with cold light, and the long sword rose into the air in his hand. He used the Gravity Art to urge the long sword to stab Lu Cheng's chest; a long sword also appeared in the hands of the second-level Qi Refining monk, and also stabbed straight into Lu Cheng's back.
The two men had evil smiles on their lips. One after the other, they launched their killing moves. Their attacks were fierce. Apparently they often did this kind of killing and hustling!
Facing the long swords coming from behind, Lu Cheng didn't panic at all. He didn't dodge or dodge. An immortal talisman instantly appeared in his hand, and the talisman was crushed by him in an instant!
boom!
The ground beneath Lu Cheng's feet suddenly cracked with a rumble, and a three-meter-wide ravine suddenly appeared under his feet. Lu Cheng's body suddenly dropped and disappeared into the crack in the blink of an eye.
"Damn!" The thin monk's smile froze. He didn't expect Lu Cheng to be so decisive. He used the immortal talisman purchased on the black market without feeling any distress at all, and quickly controlled the flying sword to return to his hand.
He and another monk on the second level of Qi Refining came to the edge of the crack and looked inward. Endless dust poured out from the crack in the ground, and Lu Cheng could not be seen.
Just when the two of them used spiritual energy to empty out the dust in the cracks in the ground and look for Lu Cheng's figure,
Boom!
Suddenly, a burst of fire shot out from a crack in the ground at an extremely fast speed. The second-level Qi Refining monk was unable to dodge, and the fireball hit his face directly.
"Ahhhh..." The second-level Qi Refining monk wailed in pain instantly, and the fireball gradually swallowed his entire body. He quickly fell to the ground, rolling left and right, trying to extinguish the flames on his body.
The thin monk was startled and quickly jumped to the other side of the crack in the ground to help his companion put out the fire.
The moment he jumped over the crack in the ground, a long sword suddenly appeared in the crack in the ground. The sword was extremely fast, rising into the air like lightning, and stabbed straight into his butt.
The skinny monk suddenly felt a chill down there, and a chill surged into his heart. He secretly thought, "No, I've fallen into a trap." It was too late to dodge, and he could only try his best to make a long jump like a 100-meter sprint.
laugh!
The long sword sank into the sole of his foot, which he didn't pull back in time, like cutting tofu!
The thin monk's foot was pierced, and he jumped to the opposite side with a long sword pierced through his foot. Then he rolled around and cried in pain.
Lu Cheng jumped up, reached the ground, rushed towards the thin monk, pulled out the long sword on his feet, and in the shocked eyes of the thin monk, directly chopped off the head of another second-level Qi Refining monk beside him.
